summary.text: Rick Lewis is a Republican member of the Oregon House of Representatives for House District 18, which his legislative page associates with Silverton.
He was appointed to the seat in February 2017 and is serving his fourth term, according to his biography.

paragraphs.text: Before coming to the legislature, Lewis was mayor and interim city manager of Silverton and served 14 years as Silverton's police chief, retiring from law enforcement in 2012.
His biography says he has more than 39 years in law enforcement, including 28 years as chief of police in three Oregon cities.
In 2005 he took a leave of absence to train and supervise the Iraqi Police Executive Leadership Training Program in Baghdad under the U.S. Department of Justice.

Lewis is a Vietnam-era veteran who served three years in the U.S. Army and two years in the Wyoming National Guard, and he graduated from the University of Wyoming with a bachelor's degree in criminal justice.
He was appointed to the Oregon Criminal Justice Commission in 2022 and to the Chief Justice's Criminal Justice Advisory Committee in 2023.
He and his wife, Pat, have six grown children.
